dataset: Related disciplines among Kaplan Singapore's 13 (data/raw/kaplan-programmes.json), for the Competitiveness Index's subject part (lib/stand/disciplines.ts)
notes: Kaplan 360++'s own table, not a university rule. A pair counts both ways. A degree in a related discipline scores 70 on the subject part and passes the subject gate; the same discipline scores 100; a programme open to any background scores 80.
The site's programme data files economics under accounting-finance, business analytics under ai-data and business law under law-criminology, so those pairs carry them.

pairs.reason: Business degrees teach accounting and finance as core modules, and economics sits in accounting & finance here.
Marketing is a business function; business degrees teach it as a core module.
Business analytics master’s are taught in business schools and built on business modules.
Hospitality and tourism management is business management in one industry.
Business law and commercial law join the two fields.
Construction management degrees teach project, cost and commercial management.
Fintech and financial analytics use the same statistics and data tools.
Data science and AI are built on programming, databases and computing theory.
Both study audiences, media and messages; advertising and public relations sit in both.
Educational psychology, child development and school counselling join the two fields.
Mental health care is taught in both.
Criminology and forensic psychology study the same behaviour.
Sport and exercise psychology is taught in both.
Exercise physiology, rehabilitation and public health are taught in both.
